She smiles brightly at the camera. In the background, other people are visible near a bright counter. (2) The camera perspective shifts to a cinema service counter where a tray holds several Stitch-themed items, including popcorn boxes and drink cups. A staff member's hand is visible behind the counter arranging these items under bright indoor lighting. (3) The woman holds a Stitch popcorn box in one hand and a cup in the other, posing enthusiastically for the camera to show off the movie theater combo set. (4) A close-up view shows her hands opening a clear plastic bag and taking out a blue Stitch-shaped cup. She examines the item carefully, showing its large pink ears and black eyes to the lens. (5) She demonstrates the functionality of the cup, pointing to the straw hole on top of the head and opening a small hatch on the back of the figure's head. The background remains a slightly blurred cinema lobby. (6) She holds the cup open and points inside to show the depth and narrowness of the container, appearing to discuss its cleaning difficulty with someone off-camera. (7) She inserts a straw into the head of the Stitch figure and poses as if drinking from it, looking directly into the camera with a playful and satisfied expression.
